scope: Advanced extraction, geometry, search, page classification and offline OCR
qualification: Native analysis/search workers exercised on synthetic and frozen fixtures. OCR inference remains unqualified: no independently verified compatible local model set is provisioned. Parent Ada's own visual review remains pending.

options: filters_json.region for direct table or image-metadata analysis
capabilities.adapter: Native page text and direct table/image metadata are bounded JSON values. Regional direct tables and image metadata use native intersection filters; no image bytes are embedded in the metadata output. Whole-page text supports explicit artifact inclusion.
capabilities.limitation: Filtered text extraction is blocked after native region assembly reinserted full-page table content outside the requested region. Table/image candidate correctness still requires source review.

capabilities.evidence: An actual bounded native call for region [0,320,400,80] returned the intended top title plus Item Amount / Alpha 10 / Beta 20 from a full-page table outside the region. Original and erroneous native JSON/manifest preserved in evidence/analysis-region-text-defect. Regional spans correctly return the title alone.
capabilities.reason: Filtered branches ignore extract_tables/include_artifacts options and re-enter native full-page table assembly. Layer/ink filtered text also uses that assembly path and remains unqualified; direct character filters and region spans/words remain available.

options: actions_json: region|regions|header|footer|artifacts|clear; explicit one-based page and finite rectangles
capabilities.limits: 100 actions, 100 rectangles and 100 selected pages. Rectangle coordinates are native [llx,lly,urx,ury]. Native page-area masks use top/bottom 15 percent and can remove meaningful citations/footnotes.
capabilities.adapter: Separate native document instance; original and masked text/spans exported side by side. No PDF is serialized or rewritten. This is extraction filtering, never secure redaction.
capabilities.evidence: Actual region and multi-region removal retain unrelated numeric values; clear restores identical text/spans; header/footer/artifact false-positive fixtures retain meaningful removed content in baseline; unselected second page remains identical.

capabilities.adapter: edit_header/footer delegate directly to erase_header/footer in pinned source. sync_editor_erasures is called internally by native mask methods and has no independent durable result. App exposes canonical masks without an editor persistence session.

capabilities.output: Native character, bbox, font, weight, style, color, rotation, origin, advance and MCID properties; original source/page provenance. Native coordinates are not relabeled as top-left coordinates.
Native text, bbox/page_bbox, font/style/color, per-character widths, content sequence and provenance; complete page_text spans/chars and dimensions.
capabilities.limitation: Pinned region-filtered extract_spans ignores reading_order; the adapter rejects region plus non-default span order. Frozen A1/B1 content retention tested for all three order modes, but no universal reading-order correctness claim.
Advanced region/threshold/profile keyword arguments are supported but deprecated in 0.3.78. Optional artifact exclusion can remove real content tagged as artifacts; the source stays unchanged.

capabilities.output: All nine profiles and their actual numeric properties; native adaptive page layout parameters. Every preset reaches real word extraction tests.
capabilities.limitation: A scanned_ocr profile is only an extraction profile and does not perform OCR. Native layout analysis can fail on empty pages and may use fallback page dimensions; failures remain explicit per-analysis errors.

capabilities.output: Native geometry and stroke-inflated rendered bboxes, colors, widths, layer names and complete bounded vector operations. No geometry reconstruction or inferred table substitution.

capabilities.evidence: Actual optional-content text exclusion and nested Form XObject spot-ink discovery tests.

capabilities.limits: At most 100 selected pages; whole-document classification requires total page count <=100 even if selection is smaller.
capabilities.limitation: Classification is heuristic and recorded verbatim with signals/reasons. Empty text alone does not imply OCR requirement. has_structure_tree may swallow upstream parse errors and return false.

capabilities.adapter: Strictly parse bounded native JSON; rich extraction fixes mode=text_only, reconstruct_image_tables=false, force_ocr_pages=[], ocr_languages=[] and preserves typed native reasons/provenance.
capabilities.limitation: Structured regions are not direct table cells; full auto/forced OCR routes are gated pending verified model provisioning and inference evidence.

capabilities.output: Original category/page/message/spec section plus source SHA-256 and one-based page. Region is explicitly null because this binding supplies none. Operator-cap diagnostics mark truncation rather than successful completeness.

capabilities.limits: Pattern <=512 characters, total matches <=1000, selected/document/index pages <=100. Requests one extra match to detect overflow and rejects rather than silently truncating. Cached index cleared in finally.
capabilities.evidence: Real literal/case/word/regex searches, page coordinates, invalid regex, match overflow and source byte preservation.

capabilities.operation: oxide_analyze and other bounded extraction routes
capabilities.adapter: App never exposes live document/region objects. Explicit document page-index and region APIs supply equivalent bounded analysis operations; table/image routes retain their own contracts and do not imply all alias-specific controls are exposed.

capabilities.limits: At most 20 selected pages, hard 2GiB address-space/120-second worker bounds. Model directory comes only from trusted supervisor configuration PDF_MULTITOOL_OXIDE_MODELS, never a document/request path. Strict manifest pins pdf-oxide0.3.78, onnxruntime1.31.0 and detector/recognizer/dictionary SHA-256/size/license/source. Each file verified and privately snapshotted before native loading; no source-to-model attestation claim.
capabilities.limitation: The released Python extract_text_ocr binding enables native fallback and does not return actual OCR provenance. Nonempty result is labeled native_or_ocr_returned and inference_verified=false; baseline stays separate. Verified inference with compatible models is still required. Hash integrity tests use explicitly synthetic non-model bytes and do not claim OCR success.

capabilities.output: Compiled OCR feature indicator, native profile names, native model registry and log-level metadata. The extension functions are public in the binary but absent from package __all__.
capabilities.limitation: The upstream model registry uses mutable resolve/main URLs without hashes. It is informational only; no automatic download or model-authenticity claim.

capabilities.reason: Automatic OCR fallback lacks the direct text method's provenance and model prefetch writes/downloads mutable upstream files. No implicit downloads or fallback model discovery are allowed. Explicit configured offline OCR and text-only rich extraction provide honest alternatives.

No arbitrary log suppression or global parser-cap relaxation is exposed to document requests. Native operator cap remains at its upstream default. Unmapped-glyph preservation defaults remain documented rather than silently changing every extraction.
Existing process supervisor owns concurrency, backpressure, cancellation and per-file failures; no unbounded upstream async task fan-out or persistent service is added.
